quotes.text: Later exact D323799 patches need a separate closed-dialog check: `[is="calendar-event-create-edit-dialog"] { display: flex; }` at raw line 359 can override native `dialog:not([open]) { display: none; }`. Open/close the dialog explicitly in layout tests and add a regression assertion that a closed connected dialog computes to `display: none`; gate flex layout to `[open]`. The fresh patch digests/review clones differ from the earlier clean sizing slice, so do not treat its 35/35 result as evidence for this defect. [Task 5]
